narrative: 规律与左弧形运镜相同，只是方向相反。向右的曲线运动可以藏起或揭示一把枪、一扇窗、或第三个人。
选择能产生新事实的方向，然后停下来。如果直线的横向平移就能让一个行走中的人保持在画面内，或者你本意是要审视一件产品的每一面，那这就是错误的工具。
how: 曲线运动，恒定半径，始终面对人物。不要让路径变直而变成推轨右移（Dolly Right）。
提示词：a 90-degree arc right around the subject, curved travel, continuous eyeline on the figure.
when: 用法与左弧形运镜相同，只是方向相反。具体情境：从说话者身上向右弧形运镜，直到听者的脸从一扇新的窗户获得主光。
不要一直持续环绕下去。
vs: 左弧形运镜是与之镜像的曲线运动。360°环绕则是完整的环视审视。
推轨右移是沿X轴的直线平移。右弧形运镜则是一段短促的方位角变化，始终以人物为中心。
examples_film: 《人类之子》围绕人体和载具重新调度机位，使危险可以从新的方位进入画面，而无需剪辑。可以把它与《好家伙》和《赎罪》中的左弧形运镜语法搭配理解：选一个方向，改变墙面，然后停下。
这是一种机制，不是可以照搬的车辆调度。
mistakes: 最常见的误用近亲是推轨右移，或者360°环绕。破绽在于：直线滑动改变了距离，或者旋转越过了那个新出现的事实。
修正方法：曲线运动、恒定半径，在新轴线处停下。

faq.q: What is Arc Right in film?
faq.a: 这是围绕主体的局部向右环绕运动，摄影机始终面对主体，用于在不剪辑的情况下改变背景和面部角度。
推轨右移是直线的横向平移。右弧形运镜则沿曲线移动，使摄影机围绕人物的方位角发生变化，而距离保持不变。

faq.q: When should I use Arc Right?
faq.a: 当新出现的墙面、窗户或倾听者位于主体右侧时使用。除非你想要的是完整环绕效果，否则不要完成一整圈。

faq.q: How do I prompt Arc Right for AI image or video?
faq.a: 写出如下要素：90-degree arc right around [Subject], always facing them, constant radius。并指明必须出现的新背景。

narrative: Same law as arc left, other side. The rightward curve can hide or reveal a gun, a window, a third person.
Choose the direction that produces the new fact, then stop. It is the wrong tool if a linear truck would keep a moving walker framed, or if you meant to inspect every side of a product.
how: Curved travel, constant radius, always facing the figure. Do not let the path straighten into a dolly-right.
Prompt a 90-degree arc right around the subject, curved travel, continuous eyeline on the figure.
when: Use it as arc left, other side. Concrete beat: arcing right off a speaker until the listener's face takes the key from a new window.
vs: Arc Left is the mirrored curve. 360-Degree Orbit is the full inspection.
Dolly Right is a straight X translate. Arc right is a short azimuth change that keeps the person as center.
examples_film: Children of Men relocates around bodies and vehicles so danger can enter from a new compass point without a cut. Pair it with the left-arc grammar in Goodfellas and Atonement: pick a side, change the wall, stop.
Mechanism, not a car to copy.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a Dolly Right or 360-Degree Orbit. The tell is a straight slide that changes distance, or a spin past the new fact.
The fix: curve, constant radius, stop at the new axis.

faq.q: What is Arc Right in film?
faq.a: It is a partial rightward orbit around a subject, camera still facing them, used to change background and face angle without a cut.
Dolly right is a straight lateral truck. Arc right travels a curve so the camera's compass heading around the person changes while distance holds.

faq.q: When should I use Arc Right?
faq.a: When the new wall, window, or listener is to the right around the subject. Do not complete a circle unless you wanted an orbit.

faq.q: How do I prompt Arc Right for AI image or video?
